text:
deploybot: Automatic pause: rollout v2.19.0 slot 77 quarantined after sustained 502/503 responses from EU control-plane health checks. Quarantine time 16:43 UTC.
ana.pm: ack — how broad is the impact (zones/percent)?
frank: eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 show the most noise, roughly 6% of total EU traffic. traces show token fetch failures. looks like control-plane proxy churn.
ops-oncall: investigating proxy fleet; seeing increased connection resets after a config push. ETA 30m for mitigation or rollback of proxy config.
release-manager: do NOT auto-rollback the application. pin the release to avoid half rollouts and prepare customer comms if this shifts windows.
cli-admin: pinning now: `deployctl pin --svc inference-api --ver v2.19.0 --slot 77 --reason "INC-9001 proxy-churn"` Added tag hold/INC-9001.
deploybot: Pin recorded. Slot 77 quarantined; subsequent slots paused. Canary traffic drained to last-known-good.
lucy: I'll prep a brief status update and add the incident link in the release doc. Anyone want me to include rollback steps?
frank: prep rollback but don't execute unless we confirm app-level regressions. rollback dry-run in staging passed. rollback command below for SRE standby:
```
# rollback to stable v2.18.5
deployctl rollback --service inference-api --from-version v2.19.0 --to-version v2.18.5 --reason "INC-9001" --force
```
ops-oncall: if ops confirms proxy config is root cause, we should prefer reschedule and a targeted canary after proxy rollback. if it's app-related, we'll rollback immediately.
incident-bot: INC-9001: EU control-plane proxy churn detected after config push; mitigation in progress. Next update in 10m.
nana.pm: proposal: keep pin, reschedule remaining slots to maintenance window 2026-03-22 04:00-06:00 UTC; plan a 10% pre-window canary at 03:30 UTC for early validation. leave slot 77 quarantined until verification.
release-manager: sounds reasonable. draft customer blurb: short apology + note that scheduled changes in EU may be delayed and that we're running a verification canary early morning UTC. link INC-9001.
cli-admin: annotated deploy ticket with reschedule and owners: @frank for rollback readiness, @ops-oncall for final go/no-go, @lucy for comms.
frank: also created hotfix branch `hotfix/proxy-retry-tuning-2026-03-21` in case we need an application-side tweak. dry-run looked good in staging.
lucy: queued the customer-facing blurb for review. internal release doc updated with pin, rollback command, hotfix branch, and reschedule times.
deploybot: Noted. Next retry for slot 78 moved to 2026-03-22T03:30:00Z (10% canary). slot 77 remains quarantined.
ops-oncall: mitigation applied (proxy config rolled back); metrics trending down toward baseline for last 8m. recommend keeping pin and running the 03:30 canary as planned. do NOT auto-unquarantine slot 77.
release-manager: final plan: reschedule remaining slots to 2026-03-22T04:00:00Z, run 10% canary at 03:30 UTC for verification; if canary passes, resume rollout; if canary shows regressions, execute rollback command above and coordinate hotfix. please post final signoff in thread before any rollback.
frank: acknowledged. rollback dry-run ready. I'll be on standby for execution if SRE flags app-level issues.
nana.pm: adding a short postmortem bullet to the release doc: root-cause (proxy config), decision to pin, rollback readiness, reschedule and canary plan, owners. will expand after the canary.
incident-bot: INC-9001 updated: proxy rollback successful; monitoring for regressions.
lucy: customer blurb approved and scheduled. release doc will be merged after successful canary. thanks team. :thumbsup:
